item.title: Companies and Social Networks
item.description:
A survey carried out by Scup.Ideias showed the impact Brazilian companies experienced from social media, the study was based on Facebook and Twitter. The survey showed the use of social networks to reduce complaints filed with PROCON, as well as to maintain an image of companies’ commitment to consumers, based on their response time through social networks, which, believe me, is surprising, but disappointing.

Companies’ average response time is three hours, with 91% of the companies surveyed seeking to respond immediately when questioned by consumers, but when it comes to solving the problem they’re not so effective, and thus don’t meet expectations for their service.

item.title: Increase your sales with Email Marketing
item.description: In the first half of 2012 e-commerce sales increased by around 20% compared with the same period in 2011, representing R$ 10.2 billion in sales, these figures were provided by e-bit, which believes this phenomenon was due to increased employment, better income distribution, easier access and low costs for web browsing. However, the promotional tool email marketing played a major role, since 5.6 million consumers made their first purchase after receiving stores’ offer campaigns by email.

item.title: What is the Blogosphere?
item.description:
According to Wikipedia, Blogosphere is the collective term encompassing all weblogs or blogs as a community or social network. Many blogs are densely interconnected. Bloggers read each other’s blogs, create links to them, refer to them in their own writing, and post comments on each other’s blogs. Because of this, interconnected blogs have created their own culture.

While a blog tries simply to present content, using resources such as text, images, videos, etc., the Blogosphere is a collective term whose aim is to encompass all blogs as a community or social network. In this way, the term can be considered a social phenomenon.

item.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
item.description: Through a set of techniques, methods and studies known as SEO (from the English “Search Engine Optimization”, which translates as “Otimização dos Mecanismos de Busca”), we can improve your pages’ position, in other words, when a user types a keyword into a search engine, the goal of SEO is to make one (or several) of your website’s pages appear among the first organic search results. Examples of search engines are Google, Bing and Yahoo.
